StringProperty.Name: RxdkXeniaPath
StringProperty.Description: Full path to the Xenia executable (including the .exe), e.g. D:\xenia\xenia_canary.exe. When set, F5 / Ctrl+F5 launches this title's XEX in Xenia.

StringProperty.Name: RxdkXeniaArgs
StringProperty.Description: Extra command-line arguments passed to Xenia after the XEX path (e.g. --license_mask=-1).

BoolProperty.Name: RxdkXeniaHeadless
BoolProperty.Description: Pass --headless=true so Xenia runs without its window (useful for smoke tests / capturing the log). Default: off, so the emulator window is shown.

BoolProperty.Name: RxdkXeniaUseIso
BoolProperty.Description: Build an Xbox 360 disc image (XISO/GDFX) from the title and any content folder, and boot THAT in Xenia instead of the bare XEX. Use this when the title expects a disc layout (game:\ media, etc.). The XEX is placed at the disc root as default.xex.

StringProperty.Name: RxdkXeniaDiscDir
StringProperty.Description: Optional folder whose contents are laid into the disc root alongside default.xex (your media / game-data folder). Leave empty for a disc containing just the title.

StringProperty.Name: RxdkXdvdfsPath
StringProperty.Description: Path to the xdvdfs executable (Team-Resurgent/XDVDFS-TR) used to pack the disc image. Defaults to the RXDK host-tools copy if present; set it if xdvdfs is elsewhere.
